Threatened Dreams Quest

General

Aliases

Feyrist Quest

Est. Length

?

Quest Log

Threatened Dreams Quest

Requirements

Premium

✓

Level

30
(100 recommended)

Other

Version

11.40.5409
July 25, 2017
Summer Update 2017

Status

Active
See also: Quests

Legend

The nightmares that live in Roshamuul are threatening the peaceful existence of the inhabitants of Feyrist.

Location

Fields of Glory, Poacher Caves, Edron, Cormaya, Ulderek's Rock, Venore, Darashia, the Devourer, Feyrist, Candia, and more.

Dangers

Wolves, Bears, Boars, Poachers, many kinds of Orcs, Lions, Feyrist creatures.

Reward

Access to Feyrist, Butterfly Ring, 5 Ancient Coins, 5 Rainbow Quartzes, Blossom Bag, Sun Catcher, Moon Mirror, Starlight Vial and Swan Feather Cloak.

Spoiler • edit


Requirements

  • Troubled Animals
    • 1x Rake;
  • A Dream Come True
    • Any melee weapon;
    • 2x Small Enchanted Amethysts;
    • 2x Small Enchanted Emeralds;
    • 2x Small Enchanted Rubys;
    • 2x Small Enchanted Sapphires;
  • An Unlikely Couple
    • Panpipes;
  • The Swan Feather Cloak
    • Completed A Dream Come True mission;
  • Sweet Dreams
    • Completed A Dream Come True mission;
    • Access to The Flaming Orchid boss (requires Asura Palace Quest);
    • Access to Katex Blood Tongue boss (requires Blood Brothers Quest up to mission 3, and The Curse Spreads and An Ancient Feud missions of the Grimvale Quest);
    • Invisibility ( Stealth Ring or Invisible spell)
    • 1x Flour;
    • 1x Milk;
    • 1x Bar of Chocolate;
    • 1x Raspberry;
    • 1x Lemon;
    • 1x Moon Melon;

Method









































Browse Map (32613, 31738, 7)

Find Alkestios just south-west (32613, 31738, 7) of the Ab'Dendriel gates. Ask him for a mission and agree to help him.

Troubled Animals

Creation of Legends









































Browse Map (32754, 31928, 7)

The Poacher Caves

Your first mission is to enter the Poacher Caves (here (32754, 31928, 7)) and find a Book with Old Legends. Go through the southern passages and descend to floor -4. Open the chest behind a door in the southern part of the room, here (32787, 31975, 11).

Once you have the book, travel to Ankrahmun and ask the shopkeeper Ahmet (next to the bank) about your book. He will offer to help as long as you are willing to pay 5,000 gold. Agree to receive Book with Old Legends (Doctored).

Return to the room in Poacher Caves where you first found the book, and use it on the table, right next to the dripping candles. If done correctly, the book will vanish and your quest log will be updated with the message You are placing the book on the table, hopefully the poachers will discover it soon.. Report your success to Alkestios. He will send you to Ikassis for your next mission.

The Ghost of a Wolf









































Browse Map (33127, 31714, 7)

Travel to Edron and walk here (33127, 31714, 7). Greet Ikassis, ask her for a mission, and accept it. She will tell you to seek out Ghostly Wolf on Cormaya and give you a Fae Talisman to allow for communication between you two.









































Browse Map (33333, 32052, 7)
Go here (33333, 32052, 7) at night, ask Ghostly Wolf for a mission, and accept it.









































Browse Map (32949, 31810, 7)

Now make your way to Ulderek's Rock and use the Pile of Bones (Quest) here (32950, 31810, 7), next to the Sleeping War Wolf (You discover a sleeping wolf in this tent. Could it be the one you are searching for?) to obtain Notes of a Poacher.

Now go to Venore and ask Irmana about fur. She will sell Fur of a Wolf Whelp to you for 1,000 gps. Take the fur back to Ghostly Wolf and report the progress of your mission to her. Use the fur on the Weeping Stone (Tears) (You place the whelp fur in the stone's mouth and thus lay it to rest.), and say whelp to Ghostly Wolf. Go back to Ikassis and confirm to her that you've fulfilled the mission Ghostly Wolf asked you to. She will send you to A Swan, who is located here (33187, 31733, 7).

Note: you can lay the whelp fur to rest even during the day when Ghostly Wolf is not there. Your quest log will update, but the mission will not be considered complete - you will still need to talk to Ghostly Wolf before you will be able to turn the mission in to Ikassis.

The Swan Maiden









































Browse Map (33200, 31893, 7)





































Browse Map (33263, 32346, 7)

Greet A Swan, ask her for a mission, and accept it. A Swan will direct you to Chief Grarkharok (you can check the Troll Sabotage Quest for instructions on how to reach him, but this part is optional) to ask about the cloak. You can go straight to Tereban (just above Edron's depot) and ask him about a cloak instead (this part is mandatory to proceed the quest). You now must find five piles of Swan Feathers in five different locations:

  • South of Edron (33200, 31893, 7) (You found some beautiful swan feathers on the grass near the wheat.)
  • East in Darashia (33266, 32422, 7) (You found some beautiful swan feathers in the dustbin.).
  • North of Darashia (33263, 32378, 7) (You found some beautiful swan feathers entangled in the cactus stings.)
  • North of Darashia (33258, 32315, 7) (You found some beautiful swan feathers beneath the dragon skull.)
  • North of Darashia (33250, 32267, 6) (You found some beautiful swan feathers under the dead tree.)

Stepping near each pile will place one Tattered Swan Feather in your Inventory. Once you have visited all five spots and obtained five feathers, go back to A Swan and report your mission.

Now go back to Alkestios and he will tell you that you have earned the trust of the Fae and are allowed to visit Feyrist. To do so, obtain a Small Amethyst, Small Emerald, Small Ruby or Small Sapphire, go through any elemental archway found in temples and use the corresponding gem on the Holy Shrine you find inside. Different shrines will send you to different places on Feyrist.

The Fairy Treasure

The Tooth Fairy

Go to Tooth Fairy south of the Suntower outside Ab'Dendriel and ask her for a mission. She will ask you to deliver some Presents to several children who have recently lost a Milk Tooth. You have to visit Quero's daughter's room in Thais (here (32390, 32220, 6)), Allen's son's room in Venore (here (33000, 32061, 5)), and Rowenna's daughter's room in Carlin (here (32325, 31794, 6)). In each room, use the Chest of Drawers (Quest) to obtain a Milk Tooth (You have found a milk tooth.) and use one of the Presents on a Bed (Quest) near it (You are placing the present for Quero's/Rowenna's daughter/Allen's son on the pillow.). Report back to Tooth Fairy by saying mission and she will give you a Part of an Old Map (Upper Left).

In addition, Tooth Fairy has an optional task for you that consists of obtaining several sorts of teeth for her collection. She wants an Orc Tooth, Shark Teeth, Vampire Teeth, a Perfect Behemoth Fang, a Carrion Worm Fang, and Werewolf Fangs. She will reward you with a White Pearl for each of these items, and once you've brought her all of them and you've finished the main mission above you'll receive the Toothfairy Assistant achievement.

Tired Trees

Find the Tired Tree north of the Fields of Glory, here (32309, 31651, 7), and ask for a map. The tree will tell you that it wants a bedtime story about Dryads and will ask you for your help. The story is held within a book called The Seeds of Life, which is located in Ab'Dendriel's library, but you don't have to go there. Ask for a mission or map again, confirm that you have found the story and then say the books name, The Seeds of Life. You will receive a Part of an Old Map (Bottom Left).

Beset Stones

For this part you need a Rake, buy one in Venore here (32888, 32087, 6).

Now you must go to the Grumpy Stone, which is located between Kazordoon and Femor Hills, here (32620, 31864, 7). These Fae need your help scratching their backs since they are stuck in this form and their stony backs are itching, but they cannot scratch themselves. After asking for a mission, use the rake on all 5 sentient stones around the Grumpy Stone. Report your mission to proceed and receive a Part of an Old Map (Upper Right)

The Last Part

Grumpy Stone will tell you that the last part of the map is hidden in a Big Fly Agaric somewhere on the Fields of Glory. You can find it just south of the Tired Tree, here (32320, 31702, 7).

You discover the fourth map part between the big fly agaric's gills.

Use it to put all map pieces together and get an Old Map. Use the map to find out where the treasure is hidden:

The old map is artfully drawn. It tells you to search for a stone sun mosaic in the very south of Thais.

Go to the sun mosaic here (32364, 32416, 7) and use the small stones in its center.

You discover something shiny that is hidden beneath the stones.

You will receive a Butterfly Ring, 5 pieces of Rainbow Quartz and 5 Ancient Coins.

A Dream Come True

Required equipment:

  • Any Melee Weapon
  • 2x Small Enchanted Amethyst
  • 2x Small Enchanted Emerald
  • 2x Small Enchanted Ruby
  • 2x Small Enchanted Sapphire

Find the NPC Maelyrra at the center (33485, 32237, 7) of Feyrist, and offer your help to combat the invasion of nightmare creatures by rebuilding the magical barrier that protects Feyrist from Roshamuul. Your first mission is to kill 200 Enfeebled Silencers and Weakened Frazzlemaws in cave near the mountain here (33546, 32267, 7), as well as the boss Kroazur, which is accessible from the portal here (33619, 32303, 9) (Note: Kroazur's lair is free access. You can kill it once every two real life hours. It drops good loot). Report your mission back to Maelyrra and ask for the next one.

Your next mission is to free 5 fairies that have been taken prisoner by evil creatures (using a melee weapon to break the energy barrier and then using the fairy) and also retrieve the Dark Moon Mirror. They are located on three different caves, all filled with Feyrist dark creatures:

  • This small cave (33424, 32215, 7), north-west from the town area. There is one fairy here.
  • This small cave (33492, 32292, 7), south-west from the town area. There is one fairy here.
  • This large cave (33554, 32211, 7), south-east from the earth shrine. This is the largest cave, with two floors. The remaining three fairies and the Dark Moon Mirror are located here. On floor -1, there are two fairies: here (33577, 32185, 8) and here (33622, 32214, 8). On floor -2, the fairy is here (33559, 32202, 9) and the Dark Moon Mirror is here (33593, 32214, 9), inside a Tree Stump.

Note: After being used, it will take one minute for the fairy to appear again so it can be freed by another player. Report your mission back to Maelyrra.

When you ask for your next mission, Maelyrra will tell you to obtain an Empty Starlight Vial from Aurita and a Dark Sun Catcher from Taegen. You can ask them for these items after you complete the An Unlikely Couple mission. After you finish this mission, talk to Taegen and give him 2 of each small enchanted gems (Small Amethysts, Emeralds, Rubies and Sapphires). Once you have the items, go back to Maelyrra and ask for a mission.

Now you need to collect three different light types using the items you just received:

  • To collect Sun light, go to the beach shaped like a snake head on the northeast of the island (here (33513, 32165, 7)), during day, and use the Dark Sun Catcher so it becomes a Shining Sun Catcher.
  • To collect Moon light, go to the glade north-east of town (here (33523, 32211, 7)) and use the Dark Moon Mirror during night, it will change into a Lit Moon Mirror.
  • To collect Star light, go up the mountain to the Energy Shrine (here (33529, 32301, 4)) and use the Empty Starlight Vial during night, it will change into a Gleaming Starlight Vial.

After charging all three light items go back to Maelyrra and report your mission.

Your final mission will be to use the light sources in specific places around Feyrist to repair the magical barrier. Each item must be used 5 times, meaning you will have to visit 15 different places.

  • Find the 5 Stone Mosaics and use the Shining Sun Catcher on them during the day (map (33495, 32234, 7)).
  • Find the 5 Dream Bird Trees and use the Gleaming Starlight Vial on them at night (map (33496, 32234, 7)).
  • Find the 5 Moon Sculptures and use the Lit Moon Mirror on them at night (four on ground level here (33495, 32233, 7), one on mountain here (33511, 32319, 6)).





































Browse Map (33495, 32234, 7)





































Browse Map (33496, 32234, 7)





































Browse Map (33497, 32234, 7)

After repairing all 15 spots, go back to Maelyrra to report your success. She will inform you that the barrier is strong once again thanks to your efforts and gift you a Blossom Bag. Once the items have been completed don't recharge them before delivering the quest otherwise you will get the quest version of the item which has no defensive stat and there is currently no way of fixing it (bug).

Note: After repairing all magical barriers, your light sources will be changed to their empty/dark version again. After completing the quest, you can go back to the charging places during the correct time of the day and charge them once more, turning them permanently into the versions with elemental protection which can be equipped in the Extra Slot (Sun Catcher, Starlight Vial and Moon Mirror).

  • Use the Dark Sun Catcher on the northeast of the island (33513, 32165, 7) during the day.
  • Use the Dark Moon Mirror on the glade northeast of town (33523, 32211, 7) during the night.
  • Use the Empty Starlight Vial on the mountain close to the Energy Shrine (33529, 32301, 4) during the night.

An Unlikely Couple

Required equipment:

  • Panpipes

Travel to Feyrist through an Ice Shrine and end up on a beach. Go north and find Aurita. Talk to her, saying mission, and she will tell you that she needs help transforming her fishtail into legs so she can meet her love Taegen. Find the Dancing Fairy southeast of Aurita and ask her about fishtail or spell and she will instruct you to get Magical Music Notes. To get the notes, you need to play the panpipes on the island in the middle of Feyrist's lake. You can reach the lake swimming from the beach on its east side. Go back to Aurita and deliver her the notes.

Talk to Taegen and ask about mission. He will ask for a Raven Herb, which you can get from different Ferns around Feyrist during the night. The closest one is here (33495, 32197, 7).

The Swan Feather Cloak

Note: You can only start this mission after finishing A Dream Come True.


































Browse Map (33502, 32232, 7)

Go to Valindara (only during day time) and ask her about her swan cloak. She will tell you that she can craft one for you if you give her 100 Swan Feathers. These can be obtained by stepping on 8 different spots around Feyrist during daytime, all of them near Swans (see map (33502, 32232, 7)). You can get 5 feathers from each spot (a total of 40 feathers) every 20 hours, which means you will need at least 3 days to gather all 100 Swan Feathers. Once you have them, go back to Valindara and deliver the feathers by saying swan cloak and yes. Wait 20 hours and come back to her to receive your Swan Feather Cloak.

Sweet Dreams

Access to Candia

Go to Feyrist and walk to the east part of the island, around (here (33574, 32222, 7)). When you spot a big donut, walk under it, and then meet with NPC Maelyrra (here (33484, 32237, 7)).

Talk to her about the donut and she tells you it leads you to Candia but in order to use it you need a Gingerbread Key. Unfortunately all have been eaten and the recipe was stolen by a forest fury that escape to Vandura.

Go to Liberty Bay and enter the Corym Black Market (here (32268, 32837, 7)). Walk through the area until you reach the -4 floor and meet A Captive Forest Fury (here (32296, 32837, 11)). It will ask your help to leave their prison and tell you that in order to do that you need a spell to make it invisible as well as make an illusion of it so Coryms will still think it's in there.

Go another two floors down and get an Intricate Cage Key (here (32295, 32794, 13)). Right after, walk all the way back to the surface floor and talk to Charlotta on the mirror image to create the forest fury's illusion. Pay her the requested 1,000 gps and return to the forest fury while invisible (use Invisible spell or equip a Stealth Ring).

Use the Intricate Cage Key on the cage and leave again to surface level. Make sure to do the entire process while invisible. Once again back to surface level, you will receive the "A Friend in Need" achievement and the Gingerbread Key Recipe.

The instructions in the recipe tell you you need a soft chocolate dough, shape it into a key format, glaze it with Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon sirups, and bake with the baking tins in Feyrist.

In order to make the chocolate dough, you need to use Flour on a container with Milk to obtain Lump of Cake Dough, then use this dough on a Bar of Chocolate to obtain a Lump of Chocolate Dough.

To make the sirups you will need the previously mentioned fruits and Sugar (Quest):

  • Moon Melon is obtained on Feyrist surface level but can only be obtained during the night
  • Raspberry and Lemon can be bought from NPCs Talila or Valindara, also in Feyrist
  • The sugar cubes are located in three distinct underground caves:
    • Northwest cave (here (33423, 32214, 8))
    • South cave (here (33495, 32285, 8))
    • Northeast cave (here (33570, 32186, 9))

Use the sugar cubes on each fruit and you'll get Flask with Lemon Sirup, Flask with Moon Melon Sirup and Flask with Raspberry Sirup.

Go to the oven in Feyrist (here (33517, 32231, 6)) and use your chocolate dough on it. Note that the key will appear on top of the oven and anyone around you could pick it up. Then use the sirups (in order: moon melon, raspberry and lemon) to finally obtain Gingerbread Key (Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon) and be granted access to Candia.

Talking to the NPCs

When you first arrived to Candia, you can't speak to the NPCs and they will use gestures, trying to tell you what you need to do. To gain the ability to speak to the NPCs, you must find the Candy Lipstick at the top of the Gingerbread Castle (here (33433, 32143, 4)) and then use it. Note that you will not be able to retrieve the lipstick if you did not greet the NPC downstairs first.

Stolen Sweets

After gaining the ability to speak with the NPCs, you should ask Sugar Plum Fairy just below you for a mission. She will tell you about her favorite sweets that were stolen by Kroazur and she wants you to bring them back.

You now need to go to Kroazurs lair in Feyrist (here (33619, 32305, 9)) and kill the boss. From Kroazur you will loot the first sweet, and a note telling you that he has sold the other sweets to other bosses.

Those bosses being, Katex Blood Tongue, The Flaming Orchid and Gorga. You will need to kill these bosses to get sweets and bring them back to Sugar Plum Fairy.

Kroazur will drop Matcha Turtle, Katex drops the Rainbow Waffles, Flaming orchid drops the Rose Milk Cake, Gorga drops the Nightsky Cupcake,

When you have all the items, return to Sugar Plum Fairy, say the name of the sweet to complete this part of the quest.

She will thank you and send you to help out in the chocolate mines.

Chocolate Mines

To enter the Chocolate mines, you enter this hole (here (33369, 32167, 7)). Be careful, as there will be Nibblemaw and Candy Horror in the chocolate mines.

Find Candis (here (33364, 32140, 8)) and ask them for a mission. They will tell you about a portal that their workers have been told to stay away from, but they think some workers have gone too close out of curiosity. You will need to go in to the portal (here (33399, 32201, 9)) and in there you will have to fight Sugar Daddy to free Candis' workers.

Sugar Daddy will occasionally spawn minor harmless candy fae, you will have to kill them so you can continue dealing damage to Sugar Daddy. If you do not kill them in a certain period of time, you will get a intense hex debuff, which will make you deal low damage to the boss and heal less.

After killing the boss, you can leave the room and you'll see Sugar Cube Worker running away as you exit the bossroom. You can kill these for bestiary with no consequences.

Return to Candis and say mission, they will thank you for your help and ask for your help again, with stabilizing the mines. There is a chest just north of Candis with candy canes, grab those and use them at three locations in the mine. Two of the locations are on the -1 floor of the mine and the third one is on the -2 floor. To repair the structures, simply use the candy canes on the broken piece on the wall.

-1







































Browse Map (33381, 32152, 8)
-2








































Browse Map (33411, 32174, 9)
After repairing all three locations, go back to Candis and say mission to report. Ask him for mission again, and he will give you 5 jars. Go down to -2 and catch 5 Honey Elementals into the jar. Once you got that then go back to the NPC and report your mission.

He will thank you for your help and send you to Sugar Plum Fairy. When you return to her, say mission and she will also thank you and say that the Candy Carnival is open again!

You can now trade with Coco and Toffee for candy things, they are located at the Candy Carnival just south of the Chocolate Mine entrance.

Family Feud

Go and talk with Dulcineo (here (33349, 32164, 7)) and he will be happy that the Candy Carnival is open again, but he is worried that the feud between Sugar Plum Fairy and her sister, the Tooth Fairy is wearing his lady, Sugar Plum Fairy, down. He wants you to help solve this by going and talking with the Tooth Fairy which you can find here (33514, 32249, 7).

When talking with the Tooth Fairy she is worried about the children's teeth because of all the candy so she wants you to bring toothbrushes to three children and placing it on their pillows.

Rowenna's child in Carlin here (32324, 31795, 7), simply use the toothbrush on the headpart of the bed on the floor above Rowenna.

Quero's child in Thais here (32390, 32221, 7), simply use the toothbrush on the headpart of the bed on the floor above Quero.

And finally Allen's child in Venore here (33008, 32060, 5), simply use the toothbrush on the headpart of the bed.

Return to the Tooth Fairy and report your success by saying mission she will be happy and give you a Pegasus Feather for your help.

Now return to Dulcineo and say mission to finish the quest.

Put the Cherry in the Cage

Note: This part doesn't have any rewards, but it's required to mark the whole quest as completed.

Go to Sugar Plum Fairy and say taffy bunny. She'll tell you that one of her taffy bunnies, Cherry, is lost and she asks you to keep an eye out for Cherry on your travels through Candia. Go downstairs to the Dessert Dungeons and you'll receive the following message, indicating Cherry might be close: You discover a tuft of spun pink sugar on the floor. Could the missing taffy bunny Cherry be down here?

Run southwest, here (33414, 32189, 8), and you'll see A Taffy Bunny walking around. When you try to interact with her, you'll receive some messages saying that she's too fast for you to catch her. Go back and report bunny to Sugar Plum Fairy.

Transcripts

Troubled Animals

Creation of Legends

Player: hi
Alkestios: Nature's blessing, traveller!
Player: mission
Alkestios: I indeed have some troubles since I'm travelling this part of the world. When I took over the body of a white deer I wasn't aware that such an animal is a sought after quarry for hunters and poachers. ...
Alkestios: Now I'm living in the constant danger of being caught and killed. Of course, I could just take over another animal but this deer has really grown on me. I'd like to help this beautiful stag but I need your assistance. Are you willing to help me?
Player: yes
Alkestios: Your decision honours you. However, if you consider killing the poachers in question I ask you to halt. We, the fae, are rather peaceful beings and abhor bloodshed. Therefore, we must find another way to solve this problem. ...
Alkestios: I already have an idea: Some birds told me that poachers are a superstitious lot. Perhaps we can get them with their own misbelief. I know that the poachers have a kind of camp north of the Green Claw Swamps. ...
Alkestios: Please search it out and examine it closely. Perhaps you will find something you can use against them in order to stop them from hunting white deer.

Threatened Dreams Quest

Player: hi
Alkestios: Nature's blessing, traveller!

Alkestios: I see, you found a book that contains old myths and legends about the woods and the forest animals. This could be of some use for us. If you find someone who could add a story ... Let's say about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer. ...
Alkestios: As I said, poachers are rather superstitious. If they would read such a story in an old book, they probably would believe it to be true. In this case they might stop hunting me.

Ahmet: So if you want to make sure they read this anytime soon, perhaps don't hide the book in a shelf or chest. Make sure to place it somewhere where they will find it easily, like very obviously on a table or something.

Threatened Dreams Quest

The Ghost of a Wolf

Player: hi
Ikassis: Nature's blessing, traveler!
Player: mission
Ikassis: One of my sisters, in the disguise of a nightingale, told me that {Alkestios} would send you. There is a problem which is not concerning me but a wolf mother on the small island Cormaya. ...
Ikassis: As we, the {fae}, consider ourselves guardians and protectors of plants and animals, it is important for me to help this wolf. Unfortunately, I can't do it myself because at the moment I'm bound to this vessel, this snake. ...
Ikassis: Thus I can't cross the ocean to reach Cormaya. Will you help me?
Player: yes
Ikassis: Nature's blessings! You may find the desperate wolf mother in the south of Cormaya. You will know the place because there is a big stone that looks like a grumpy face. ...
Ikassis: At night it will weep bloody tears and only at night you will meet the ghost there. Take this talisman so you may be able to talk with animals and even plants and stones. Just don't expect that all of them will answer you.

Threatened Dreams Quest

Player: hi
Ghostly Wolf: You are speaking the language of animals? I'm surprised. But I'm not in the right {mood} for a chat.
Player: mission
Ghostly Wolf: I'm heartbroken, traveler. Some months ago, I was taking care of my three newborn whelps. They just opened their eyes and started exploring the wilderness as a hunter came by. ...
Ghostly Wolf: He shot me and took my three puppies with him. I have no idea where he brought them or whether they are still alive. This uncertainty harrows me and thus I'm unable to find peace. Will you help me?
Player: yes
Ghostly Wolf: I didn't dare hope for it! The man told something about selling my babies to the orcs so they could train them as war wolves. ...
Ghostly Wolf: I guess he mentioned Ulderek's Rock. Please search for them and - be they alive or not - return and tell me what happened to them.

Threatened Dreams Quest

Player: hi
Irmana: Welcome to the house of {fashion}, Player!
Player: fur
Irmana: A wolf whelp fur? Well, some months ago a hunter came here - a rather scruffy, smelly guy. I had thrown him out instantly but he had to offer some fine pelts. One of them was the fur of a very young wolf. ...
Irmana: I was not delighted that he obviously killed such a young animal. When I confronted him, he said he wanted to raise it as a companion but it unfortunately died. A sad story. In the end, I bought some of his pelts, among them the whelp fur. ...
Irmana: You can have it if this is important for you. I would sell it for 1000 gold. Are you interested?
Player: yes
Irmana: Alright. Here is the fur.

Player: hi
